summary: Daily Closing: fix zero/nonzero money editing, bounded save with unknown-result recovery, persistent intent IDs, atomic idempotent receipts and stale-write protection for Owner/Portable. Validated locally only; no commit, push, migration or production deploy.

limitations: Browser HTTP loss and API RPC transport failure are controlled fixture faults, not a production outage test.
Owner draft uses tab session storage; Portable draft uses existing device persistence. If browser/device storage is unavailable, only in-memory draft recovery remains.
Existing correction-request/approval flows were not redesigned by this regular-save hotfix.
